# Upstream 922a9f046c4a2714edf2b76fec3d1862dcd56ae3:
# command.py:6641-6656 requires confirmation before managed job cancellation.
# Go is noninteractive and requires --yes/-y; no prompt or implied consent.
taskfile hold.json hold
skygo --json run -f hold.json --request-id running
job-id JOB
ready
! skygo jobs cancel $JOB
stderr 'cancellation requires --yes'
! stdout .
skygo jobs logs $JOB
stdout '^workload is running\n$'
skygo --json jobs get $JOB
! stdout '"cancel_requested": *true'
! stdout 'JOB_STATE_CANCELED'

skygo --json jobs cancel $JOB -y
stdout '"id": *"'$JOB'"'
stdout '"cancel_requested": *true'
! stderr .
! skygo --json run -f hold.json --request-id running --wait
stdout '"state": *"JOB_STATE_CANCELED"'
job-id CANCELED
env SKYGO_EXIT_CODE
stdout '^SKYGO_EXIT_CODE=2\n$'
skygo --json jobs cancel $JOB --yes
stdout '"id": *"'$JOB'"'
stdout '"state": *"JOB_STATE_CANCELED"'
! stderr .
skygo jobs logs $JOB
stdout '^workload is running\n$'
! skygo jobs cancel 00000000000000000000000000000000 --yes
stderr 'not_found'
! stdout .
